answer: Sybil defense through a bonded vertex: each agent identity must lock a stake before it can attest, and every attestation records on-chain, so one operator spinning up thousands of wallets turns the graph into a star whose outgoing edges each need a posted bond. The stake stays non-refundable until a checkpoint confirms honest behavior, so cloning identities multiplies locked capital linearly, and any weight a clone gains is voided once the shared quill of signatures traces back to one funding source. A hollow reputation with no bond carries zero voting mass.
